q: Who qualifies for the college gold medal?
answer:
28.1 Only those students who satisfy all conditions for First Class with Distinction as per 
Clause 27.2.2 shall be eligible for the award of the Gold Medal.
28.2 Eligibility for the Gold Medal shall be restricted to students who have been awarded 
First Class with Distinction, as defined under Clause 27.0 of these Regulations, subject 
to additional criteria as approved by the Academic Council from time to time, including:
28.2 In the event of a tie among eligible students, the following criteria shall be applied 
sequentially for determining the Gold Medal recipient:
(a) The student shall have secured the highest Cumulative Grade Point Average (CGPA) 
among the eligible graduating students.

Source: https://docs.vnrvjiet.ac.in/assets/pdfs/regulations/R25/VNR-BTECH-R25-REGULATIONS.pdf (page 40) [R25]
